item.title: Disney and Starbucks Unveil New Tumblers Paired With Mystery Pin Packs
item.description: Each collectible cup in the limited-edition series is themed after one of six U.S. Disney Parks.

item.title: Warner Bros.’ Cease-and-Desist Says TikTok Owner Made “Deliberate Design Choice” to Rip Off Its IP
item.description: The studio, which joins Paramount and Disney in sending cease-and-desists to ByteDance, accuses the company of deliberately rolling out Seedance 2.0 without safeguards.

item.title: Shia LaBeouf Released From Jail In New Orleans After Mardi Gras Bar Fight
item.description: The actor had been on an extended weekend bar crawl since Thursday, which ended in violence at a Faubourg Marigny bar in the first hours of Fat Tuesday.

item.title: CBS Says It Didn’t Kill Stephen Colbert’s Interview With Senate Hopeful. Who’s Lying?
item.description: Or: Is it a case where both versions of events are technically true? The network and the host offer dueling stories of what happened to a Texas congressman's appearance due to new FCC equal time rules.

item.title: Jane Baer, Animator on ‘Sleeping Beauty,’ ‘The Rescuers’ and ‘Who Framed Roger Rabbit,’ Dies at 91
item.description: The Winnipeg native also provided services to the industry with her companies Baer Animation and Baer Animation Camera Services.

item.title: Hollywood Divorce Lawyer Laura Wasser and Reformation Release “Dump Him” Sweatshirt
item.description: The limited-edition crewneck is part of their larger clothing drop: The Divorce Collection.

item.title: YouTube Restored After Suffering Outage Tuesday Night
item.description: For an hour, users were met with the message, "Something went wrong. Try again."

item.title: Councilmember’s Push to Improve L.A. Filming Conditions Passes Latest Hurdle: “We Can’t Lose Any More Time”
item.description: Adrin Nazarian’s nine motions aimed at making the city more film-friendly will next be considered by the entire City Council, albeit with amendments.
